name: Web resources
description: Opens a web page as a folder of the things it is made of — images, scripts, stylesheets, and the pages it links to. Read and copy; nothing is ever written back.
author: xcommander

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: example.com, or a whole https:// URL with a path

fields.label: Address
fields.hint: For a server that has no https. Everything travels in the clear.

settings.label: Show the pages it links to
settings.note: Links become folders you can walk into. Off leaves only the things the page is built from.

settings.label: Include resources from other hosts
settings.note: A page usually pulls fonts, scripts and images from elsewhere. Off shows only what this host serves.

settings.label: Follow links to other hosts
settings.note: Off keeps a walk inside the site you opened. Links off it are still listed, as files.

settings.label: Ask each resource how big it is
settings.note: One extra HEAD request per resource, several at a time. Off leaves sizes blank until a file is opened or copied.

settings.label: Respect robots.txt
settings.note: What the site asks automated readers not to fetch. Turn it off only on a site you run.

settings.label: Identify as
settings.note: Sent as User-Agent. Some sites answer differently, or not at all, without one they recognise.
